headline: A 2018 law renames a Brentwood, New York post office after Army Specialist Jose L. Ruiz.
what_it_does: The law names the U.S. Postal Service facility at 25 2nd Avenue in Brentwood, New York, the "Army Specialist Jose L. Ruiz Post Office Building." It is a naming measure and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2018, and the new name applies from that date.
